CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_td_admin_set_source_document_status(p_document_id uuid, p_status text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'app'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE app.td_source_documents SET status = p_status, updated_at = now() WHERE id = p_document_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END; $function$
